newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish currency in circulation at all time high.
newsitem.headline: Turkish currency in circulation at all time high.

text.p: Turkey's currency in circulation hit an all-time high of 634.6 trillion lira on Tuesday, the central bank said on Wednesday.

The new record was up 95 trillion lira from Monday's previous record of 539.7 trillion, mainly due to hefty mid-month public sector salary and pension payments and rising cash demand ahead of a 6-1/2-day holiday beginning from mid-Thursday.
Salary and pension payments in the state sector are estimated at 160 trillion lira in total.
